## Background

Sickle cell disease (SCD) is a group of genetic disorders in which red
blood cells contort into a sickle shape. Symptoms of SCD include anemia
(caused by misshapen cells dying early) as well as pain, infection, and
stroke (caused by sickle cells blocking blood flow). There is some
evidence that exposure to air pollution aggravates vaso-occlusion and
pain in SCD patients.

A hematologist at Duke wants to study the associations between various
air pollutants and SCD in Durham County, North Carolina. She provides
data on health system utilization (i.e., emergency department visits,
hospitalizations, etc.) for SCD and you obtain air pollution data from
the EPA. The pollutant data are raw measurements taken from the air
pollution monitor at the RDU airport. This exposure data is messy and
will need to be processed.

```{r data-processing, include=FALSE}
# Custom function reads in data and performs cleaning; set O3 units to ppb 
aq18 <- clean_aq_data("data/AQ_2018.csv", units_O3 = "ppb")
aq19 <- clean_aq_data("data/AQ_2019.csv", units_O3 = "ppb")
aq20 <- clean_aq_data("data/AQ_2020.csv", units_O3 = "ppb")

# Combine data from each year into one dataset 
aq_full <- bind_rows(aq18, aq19, aq20)
```

## Plots 
```{r plot 1}
# Create data frame with monthly summary statistics for CO and O3
monthly_summary <- aq_full %>%
  # Select date and pollutant concentrations
  select(Date, co_max8hr, o3_max8hr) %>%
  
  # Create column extracting month from date
  mutate(
    Month = factor(
      # Get three letter abbreviation format for month
      month.abb[lubridate::month(Date)],
      levels = month.abb
    )
  ) %>%

  # Reshape pollutants into one column
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(co_max8hr, o3_max8hr),
    names_to = "Pollutant",
    values_to = "Concentration"
  ) %>%

  # Group by pollutant and calendar month
  group_by(Pollutant, Month) %>%

  # Calculate monthly statistics
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    count = sum(!is.na(Concentration)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  # Calculate lower and upper bounds for each month 
  mutate(
    LB = Mean - 1.96 * SD/sqrt(count), 
    UB = Mean + 1.96 * SD/sqrt(count)
  )

# Plot monthly average concentrations for CO and O3 
ggplot(monthly_summary, aes(x = Month, y = Mean, color = Pollutant)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = LB, ymax = UB)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Pollutant,
             scales = "free_y",
             ncol = 1,
             labeller = as_labeller(c(
               co_max8hr = "CO (ppm)",
               o3_max8hr = "O3 (ppb)"))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Mean CO and O3 Concentrations",
    subtitle = "Pooled Daily Measurements, 2018–2020",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Mean Concentration",
    color = "Pollutant"
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(
    labels = c(
      co_max8hr = "CO",
      o3_max8hr = "O3"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + 
   theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0)
    )
  
```
